name: owasp-skills
description: OWASP-based security Agent Skills for AI coding assistants (Claude Code, OpenCode, and other SKILL.md-compatible tools).

plugins.name: owasp-top10-web
plugins.description: OWASP Top 10 Web Application Security Risks (2021): access control, injection, crypto, SSRF, and more.

plugins.name: owasp-api-security
plugins.description: OWASP API Security Top 10 (2023): BOLA, broken auth, rate limiting, and other API-specific risks.

plugins.name: owasp-llm-security
plugins.description: OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications (2025): prompt injection, excessive agency, insecure output handling, and MCP tool-server security.

plugins.name: owasp-asvs-secure-coding
plugins.description: OWASP ASVS turned into a prescriptive secure-coding checklist for auth, sessions, crypto, validation, and more.

plugins.name: owasp-dependency-secrets
plugins.description: Dependency (SCA) vulnerability management and secrets scanning/hygiene.

plugins.name: owasp-skills-all
plugins.description: All 5 owasp-skills bundled into a single plugin install.
